falseSynonyms.zh: A feature is often something noticeable or functional. A quality may be more abstract. Compare: - feature: fingerprint scanner - quality: reliability
falseSynonyms.point: A feature is often something noticeable or functional. A quality may be more abstract. Compare: - feature: fingerprint scanner - quality: reliability

falseSynonyms.zh: These overlap, but: - trait is especially common for people or biology - characteristic is broader Compare: - personality trait - characteristic of the material
falseSynonyms.point: These overlap, but: - trait is especially common for people or biology - characteristic is broader Compare: - personality trait - characteristic of the material

falseSynonyms.zh: Both are formal. - attribute = a quality belonging to something - property = especially a physical, scientific, or technical quality Compare: - product attribute: durability - physical property: density
falseSynonyms.point: Both are formal. - attribute = a quality belonging to something - property = especially a physical, scientific, or technical quality Compare: - product attribute: durability - physical property: density

falseSynonyms.zh: An aspect is one side of a topic. A characteristic describes what that thing is like. Compare: - social aspect of education - common characteristic of successful teams
falseSynonyms.point: An aspect is one side of a topic. A characteristic describes what that thing is like. Compare: - social aspect of education - common characteristic of successful teams

falseSynonyms.zh: A trait may be positive, neutral, or negative. A strength is positive. Compare: - stubbornness is a trait - patience is a strength
falseSynonyms.point: A trait may be positive, neutral, or negative. A strength is positive. Compare: - stubbornness is a trait - patience is a strength

falseSynonyms.zh: A weakness is specifically negative. A characteristic is neutral.
falseSynonyms.point: A weakness is specifically negative. A characteristic is neutral.

falseSynonyms.zh: A virtue is a morally good quality. Patience can be both: - a quality - a virtue But height or eye color can be a characteristic, not a virtue.
falseSynonyms.point: A virtue is a morally good quality. Patience can be both: - a quality - a virtue But height or eye color can be a characteristic, not a virtue.
